MECHANISM REFINED (fable round-1 implementation lane, 2026-07-27): the raw EAGAIN-fatal read loops this record describes were already fixed on main by aac0fcb (2026-07-22, readExactly poll-and-retry) — in every daemonkit release since v0.20.8. The surviving producer of systemCall(read, errno 35) is SessionTransport.swift:583-584: waitUntilReady converts poll()==0 (DEADLINE EXPIRY) into a synthetic EAGAIN throw, and ServiceSocketClient.provesSessionTransition (:893-:896) counts read/EAGAIN as session-teardown proof -> "bridge failed: disconnected". So the field failures on 12.20.12 are deadline expiries under load, mislabeled and then misclassified — not unretried non-blocking reads.
Orchestrator ruling for v0.20.10: (a) deadline expiry surfaces as a deadline-classified error (file's own :296 convention), never EAGAIN; (b) provesSessionTransition stops counting EAGAIN as teardown proof, client surfaces deadlineExceeded; (c) criterion 773cddb: failure sites duplicated to stderr so the plist-captured file log shows them. Implementation in flight, workflow wf_4dc05729-4af round 2.
